735090101.text: Hehe... Haha... Ahahahaha! It is a success!

735090102.text: Now I just need to hire a mercenary band and conduct a pilot deployment, with a goal to achieve basic operational capacity within ten days.

735090103.text: Once I get the frontline reports, I'll be able to convince my mentor to give me a higher budget, with which I can prove to the Akademiya that this is the alchemical potion's strongest form!

735090104.text: What's going on, why's there someone laughing herself silly in the desert's direction?

735090105.text: And what's with all the talk about mercenaries and operational capacity... This person sounds like some kinda battle maniac!

735090106.text: #What do we do, {NICKNAME}? Should we, uh, get away for a bit?

735090108.text: Eh? Oh, right. Paimon forgot that you're a combat expert yourself...

735090109.text: Speaking of which, it does tend to be that whenever you get along with someone, they'll almost certainly be willing to purchase our services.

735090110.text: As long as this person doesn't plan on doing any bad things, and the Mora is good, we can definitely consider helping out!

735090111.text: Hmm? Are you talking about me behind my—

735090112.text: Ah! It's... It's you! The golden-haired outlander and their White High-Intelligence Floating Assistive Unit!

735090113.text: Huh? You know us? Paimon doesn't remember having this nickname, though!

735090114.text: You have us at a disadvantage, Miss...

735090115.text: Ah, so you've forgotten me. But I understand. I am but a normal plebeian, while you — you are living legends!

735090116.text: A long time back, you aided my experiments with my great creation, the Remelting Tablets — alchemical potions designed to aid people in combat.

735090117.text: That research went very smoothly indeed. You enjoyed hearty battles, and I drew much useful data and inspiration from said battles.

735090118.text: It would not be wrong to say that you changed my life — and for that, I have always been thankful! The results of my research have also been of aid to some members of the Corps of Thirty in their work regarding Sumeru's security...

735090119.text: Seriously? Did we really do that? Huh, we should remember that in future, then.

735090120.text: Speaking of that, you were saying something about combat and potions earlier, weren't you?

735090121.text: Will you need our help this time as well?

735090122.text: Well, why not? With you two around, I shan't have to rub shoulders with those sellswords.

735090123.text: To tell the truth, I was worried that they might fleece me... or even rob me!

735090139.text: If you were to help me complete the verification process for my Shock-Boiled Brews, I'd be willing to give you the part of my budget I set aside for this exactly. It would also serve as further thanks for your help.

735090140.text: Mora worth fifty peoples' salaries. Not bad for remuneration, yes?

735090141.text: Fifty peoples' worth of Mora!? Doesn't that mean that we'll be set for... a long while once we do a single day of work?

735090142.text: #Sounds like a great deal, {NICKNAME}! We don't come by something like this often!

735090125.text: Huh. You're right. She does look pretty familiar.

735090126.text: Ooh, Paimon remembers! We met this person on a cliffside in the rainforest! What was her name again...
